VNEDGE-Trend-Continuation-v1.pine.idea: Closed-bar trend-following breakout of prior 48 closes, gated by EMA 24/96 alignment, efficiency ratio and ATR midrank. Native 2x SMA ATR stop and full 2R target.
VNEDGE-Trend-Continuation-v1.pine.reviewScope: Pinned upstream Python prepare/signal, regime and indicator functions; Pine port replayed against Python reference. Execution is the existing VN EDGE engine, not the upstream backtester.

entries.condition: After 264 bars: ER48 >= 0.30; EMA24 > EMA96; close exceeds the previous 48 closes (current excluded); SMA ATR24 midrank over 240 values <= 0.90; closed bar only.
After 264 bars: ER48 >= 0.30; EMA24 < EMA96; close below previous 48 closes; ATR midrank <= 0.90; closed bar only.

stop.how: Signal close minus/plus 2 times 24-bar simple-average true range. First true range is undefined; never substituted with Wilder ATR.

targets.how: One full-position target at 2 initial risk units, fixed from the signal close. No 6R fallback or partial ladder.

exit.how: Native protective stop or full target; no source reversal, trailing or timed exit. Any execution-layer liquidation remains authoritative.

timing.lookahead: Only prior closes and trailing windows, prefix-tested.
timing.note: EMA uses first-close initialization. Signals depend on supplied history. Port matches the OHLC-only adapter: funding input is absent, not verified zero funding. Exchange fills are causal engine observations, not assumed candle-close fills.
